summary: Floor & Decor Holdings filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, disclosing quarterly earnings and a new $400 million share repurchase program approved by its Board on April 23, 2026. The buyback authorizes open-market, block, privately negotiated, or accelerated repurchase trades under Rule 10b5-1 plans. No specific per-share price, premium, or expiry date was set; the program is purely discretionary with no obligation to repurchase. The filing is an Item 8.01 Other Events disclosure. The capital return signals management confidence despite a 3.7% comp-store decline. Watch for subsequent 10b5-1 plan adoption and actual repurchase pace against float.
